Chapter 661: Chapter 6 River Of Time (5000 Words, Please Subscribe)_3

Chapter 661: Chapter 6 River of Time (5000 words, please subscribe)_3

But Lin Yuan was different; he had observed the entire vista of the River of Time and had gained a concrete understanding of its past and future.

Thus, his comprehension of the Rule of Time was far clearer than that of other powerful beings who perceived the same rule.

Knowing where he currently stood, and approximately where the endpoint lay.

…

“At the Ninth Rank, penetrating the Rule of Time allows one’s inner world to ‘detach,’ and upon advancing to the Tenth Rank, accepting the infusion from the Chaos Void Origin…”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts surged.

...

That was why the Xia Qin Supreme Being paid a price and helped Lin Yuan break free from the bonds of the River of Time, giving him a push in the comprehension of the Rule of Time.

The purpose was to hope that Lin Yuan could penetrate the Rule of Time before stepping into the Tenth Rank, thereby leading the Chaos Void Origin to merge into his inner world.

Having a Supreme Being place such importance on him made Lin Yuan even more anticipative.

…

“The current priority is to thoroughly comprehend the Rule of Time.”

Lin Yuan reined in his thoughts. With the Xia Qin Supreme Being pushing him this much, if he still could not penetrate the Rule of Time at the Ninth Rank, Lin Yuan would truly feel ashamed.

“With my current pace of comprehending the Rule of Time, it should take about thirty years to truly comprehend it.”

Lin Yuan examined himself and developed a highly precise understanding of his capabilities.

“At most, thirty years.”

Lin Yuan gauged the transformation level of his inner world and immediately had an idea.

For any Ninth or Tenth Rank Evolver, thirty years was no time at all, and for Lin Yuan to be able to comprehend the Rule of Time within such a short span was utterly astonishing.

Keep in mind, before observing the full scope of the River of Time, Lin Yuan was prepared to penetrate the Rule of Time after reaching the Tenth Rank.

…

Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

The Taiyang Divine Spirit was currently practicing one of the three great Dao-Protecting Secret Skills of the Profound Yellow Lineage, “Step of Space-Time.”

Lin Yuan’s True Spiritual Body had different functions; currently, the main body mainly focused on comprehending the Rule of Time.

While the other two spirits were engaged in understanding various secret techniques, evolution paths, and so on.

As for why not have both spirits join the main body in concurrently comprehending the Rule of Time?

Lin Yuan had tried doing this, but it wasn’t very beneficial, and the efficiency did not significantly increase.

The main body focused on the Rule of Time, the other two spirits secondarily on various secret techniques, evolution paths, enabling reciprocal stimulation.

For instance, while practicing “Step of Space-Time,” understanding would often lead to insights into some essence of the Rule of Time, which fed back into the comprehension of the Rule of Time.

And deeper understanding of the essence of the Rule of Time could also stimulate the understanding of “Step of Space-Time.”

“After observing the entire scope of the River of Time, I have a deeper grasp of this secret technique.” Lin Yuan stepped forward, instantly appearing at another end of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, his expression showing enlightenment.

“Step of Space-Time,” named after ‘space-time,’ naturally involves aspects of the Rule of Time.

In fact, what enabled Lin Yuan to cover millions of light-years in one step through “Step of Space-Time” was the unbreakable application of the Rule of Time; the power erupting from the fusion of time and space far exceeded Lin Yuan’s expectations.

In the deepest parts of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

A six-armed silhouette was sitting cross-legged there.

As the consciousness of the Secret Realm, nothing happening inside escaped his control, although Lin Yuan, having refined the Core of the Secret Realm, held power over life and death over him.

“Master’s mastery in ‘Step of Space-Time’ has advanced so much?” the Six-Armed Silhouette saw Lin Yuan continuously reappearing at different spots in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm and was somewhat dumbfounded.

He clearly sensed that Lin Yuan was covering great distances, not by virtue of his ‘permissions’ within the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, but through instantaneous shifting using “Step of Space-Time.”

But was this not incredible?

To reach such a level of “Step of Space-Time,” while not fully comprehending the Rule of Time, was not far off.

Yet this new master of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm was only at the Ninth Rank life level.

Ninth Rank life, and yet already so close to fully comprehending the Rule of Time.

What would those at the Tenth Rank life, Eleventh-Rank Life think?

The Six-Armed Silhouette found it incredibly unbelievable.

Lin Yuan was making rapid progress in practicing the “Mysterious Yellow Strike” secret technique.

After all, some individuals are just adept at practicing certain secret techniques, but “Step of Space-Time?”

To advance in this secret technique relied on genuine rule comprehension, with no shortcuts or tricks.

“His Majesty once said, ‘The earlier the Rule of Time is comprehended, the better. To penetrate the Rule of Time during the Tenth Rank life stage, is already an extremely rare peerless genius among the Chaos Void.'”

“But looking at the Master’s current pace of comprehension, it is very likely that he could penetrate the Rule of Time during the Ninth Rank…”

The Six-Armed Silhouette suddenly recalled some words previously spoken by Xuanhuang.

According to Xuanhuang’s intentions, aside from certain Innate Temporal Beings, for acquired beings, comprehending the Rule of Time at the Tenth Rank was already quite remarkable.

As for the Ninth Rank? The Six-Armed Silhouette had never heard his majesty mention such a possibility, unsure whether it was unattainable or even Xuanhuang himself had not predicted it.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan held a Miniature Universe, continuously comprehending the Rule of Time operating within it.

The Rule of Time within the Miniature Universe was far from reaching the extent of forming a River of Time; it was merely a more complete segment of the rule.

However, this still somewhat reduced the difficulty of Lin Yuan’s comprehension of the Rule of Time.

“Within this Miniature Universe, all rules, including the Space Rules and Time Rules, form a stable balance, which is the most valuable aspect.”

Lin Yuan observed everything within the Miniature Universe, silently thinking.

Just as Lin Yuan was about to continue contrasting the Rule of Time within the Miniature Universe,

with his own understanding of the Time Rules.

Suddenly.

At that moment.

Lin Yuan’s eyebrows slightly furrowed.

“Someone’s looking for me?”

Lin Yuan did not stop training, but split a trace of his mind to connect to the Virtual World.
